### Party

- You keep following your party after the first game. Asking first when you are already in a game meant every game after the first one, because somebody who had just been sent to the party's game still counted as busy and got a notification to click instead of being moved. Being in the game the party is in now counts as following, so only somebody off playing their own thing is asked
- Following a launch worked only while the background party process was running. Turning that off left the party unable to move you even with PhasmaStrap open. Any part of PhasmaStrap that is watching your party can move you now, and you are still only sent once
